analysis: The PR changes only docs/developer/test.md, a developer test guide. The patch adds two suite names (`FlintPagedOnlyBackendTests`, `ModelBenchmarkDispatchTests`) to the Flint focused-suite list near head line 844. It also reworks the `DARKBLOOM_FLINT_BACKEND` sentence near head line 919 to say Flint is paged-only, so the variable may only be unset or `paged`. No executable code, keys, attestation, authorization, encryption or coordinator/provider wire behavior is modified, so the threat model's assets (A-001, A-003, A-015, A-016) and boundaries (TB-002, TB-007, TB-011) are unaffected. The base text around the change (SSD test working volume, endpoint-resumption and logout tests, prefix-cache qualification) is unchanged and not re-evaluated. It repeats existing guidance to use isolated state and never production cache roots or keys, which is consistent with T-041. The paged-only statement reflects a code-side change in a Flint backend selector. That code is not in the supplied evidence, so the doc's claim cannot be verified here. This is a documentation accuracy question, not a security regression. I found no new attack surface and no invalidated threat assumptions. Integration should note that the paged-only enforcement and the benchmark dispatch tests live in other files; their review belongs to those source units.
